Before · during · after

From visibility to conversation to pipeline.

A ninety-day programme with one day in the middle of it. Open any panel for the operational detail.

Before

Discover

Get found before the invitation lands.

  • Dedicated partner announcement
  • Social and email campaign visibility
  • Partner mention in all invite communications
  • Registration page branding
  • Pre-event delegate list at Platinum and Gold
Campaign detail

Co-branded creative and partner video at Platinum and Gold. A partner-hosted content feature is Platinum only.

Confirmation date sets your runway. Print, delegate kit assembly and campaign scheduling close ahead of 27 November. Booth, showcase and data deliverables are unaffected by a late confirmation. Print cut-off date to be confirmed.

Onboarding. Agreement and invoice on confirmation, a 30-minute call in week one on objective, speaking topic and booth, then asset handover with a named owner on each side.

During

Experience

Be in the conversation, not beside it.

  • Stage time, by tier
  • Booth and product demo area
  • Industry unconference tables of 10–12
  • 3 to 9 client passes you fill yourself
  • Main stage, LED, standee and badge presence
On-site detail

Client passes are the unusual asset. Nine at Platinum, seven at Gold, five at Silver, three at Bronze, reserved for TA and HR leaders you nominate. We handle the invitation so the ask comes from the platform.

Proposed activations sit outside every tier and are scoped separately: hosting an unconference table, a closed-door executive roundtable, a customer on stage in TA in Action, a product launch moment.

On the day your booth is built and checked before doors, with a dedicated coordinator and your team briefed before the first delegate arrives.

After

Continue

Leave with signal, not just names.

  • Delegate database, every tier
  • Partner insights report, every tier
  • Event report placement and newsletter feature
  • Aftermovie visibility and event photography
  • 15% / 10% / 5% discount on the next edition
Measurement detail

Contracted and reported: stage time delivered, MC mentions, social post counts, passes issued and taken up, database and insights report, report and aftermovie placement.

Reported where the data exists: announcement distribution, email appearances, booth and demo conversations, Expo listing interactions, seniority mix of the delivered room.

Not claimed: a guaranteed lead count, a cost-per-decision-maker figure, or attribution of your pipeline to this event. Attribution sits in your CRM, not ours.
